radiusSource: Radius 39 +/- 3.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, ST Tau: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39 +/- 3.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 27,132,300 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
